task_summary: Completed the synthetic workflow follow-up by correcting archived Gantt autosave and Adviser permissions, then verifying the browser views and focused server/client suites.
key_decisions: Treat the latest seeded account and project as synthetic test data, with the user's existing authorization for synthetic ADM sign-offs and archival.
Keep archived Gantt views read-only and suppress autosaves on load; reject archived plan updates in the project service.
Let the shared role-and-assignment policy authorize Gantt editing so the assigned Adviser remains eligible while approval stays separate.
Leave the full client suite and comprehensive server suite marked unverified after their watchdogs rather than report unsupported passes.
lessons_learned: An explicit page-level isReadOnly prop can override a shared Adviser permission and hide valid schedule editing controls.
Loading an archived plan can trigger a debounced autosave even when the viewer makes no edit; archive checks belong in both client persistence paths and the server service.
open_threads: The full client suite remains unverified after its prior 120-second watchdog; investigate the slow suite before a bounded full-suite retry.
The comprehensive server suite reached its 105-second watchdog during MongoMemoryServer configuration without reaching assertions; diagnose the startup stall before retrying.
